commit.message:
[Website] Keep Reprint authorization steps visible (#4537)

Shows copy, authorize, and clone in one fixed checklist. Copying adds an
inline confirmation and highlights the settings button without replacing
the page or moving keyboard focus.

Later buttons stay disabled until needed; their instructions remain
readable. Keeps key details collapsed, with a manual-copy fallback when
clipboard access fails. Going back keeps the same key. A late result
from copying again leaves the current setup step in place, whether the
clipboard write succeeds or fails. Retrying Copy also clears an old
clone error so focus stays on the button.

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Desktop | ![Before,
desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/before-desktop.png)
| ![After,
desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/after-desktop.png)
|
| Mobile | ![Before,
mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/before-mobile.png)
| ![After,
mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/after-mobile.png)
|

Emphasis changes in place: [after copying the
key](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/authorize-desktop.png),
[after opening
settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/edced38f6d86ffa9d9e96137d2bf8c176a2ecd60/confirm-desktop.png).

## Testing

- Open Playground with `?reprint` and choose **Clone a live site**.
- Copy the key: the checklist stays in place, focus stays on Copy, and
Tab reaches settings.
- Open settings, authorize on the live site, return, and clone.
- Copy the key again after opening settings; the final action should
stay enabled.
- Block clipboard access and use the manual-copy path.
- Go back through setup and confirm that the key stays the same.

Verified locally: 592 website unit tests, all five Reprint UI browser
tests, lint, and type checks. The new tests hold the second clipboard
write open while settings advances, then check both success and failure.
Another case checks Copy focus after clone creation fails.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai
-->
<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
* Added a guided site-connection checklist for copying a migration key,
authorizing access in Reprint, and confirming a clone or pull.
  * Added a manual key-copy option when clipboard access is unavailable.
* Improved focus behavior as setup steps advance and when transfers
stop, helping users stay oriented.
  * Preserved later setup steps when copying is retried.
* **Tests**
* Updated coverage for the connection checklist, clipboard handling,
focus behavior, and clone confirmation.
